name: UUID Generator
tagline: Random v4 or time-ordered v7 UUIDs.
description: Generate UUID v4 or time-sortable v7 IDs in bulk, upper or lower case, with or without hyphens. Free, made on your device with secure randomness.

faq.a: v4 is fully random. v7 starts with the time it was made, so IDs sort in creation order, which keeps database indexes fast.

faq.q: Are these generated on a server?
faq.a: No. They're made in this tab from your device's secure random number generator.
